currentRoundInspection.scope: Mapped exterior of the Corinne Mamane Museum of Philistine Culture in Ashdod: compact blue-gray rendered rectangular building, three reconstructed folded white sheet-roof bays/clerestory ends, largely blank front facade and raised coping, actual recessed glazed entrance under a projecting dark-edged canopy, two restrained blank banner fields and three abstract pale sign plaques. Preserve independent nearby school/tile-roof buildings and original approach. No furnished exhibition, copied inscriptions, bird logo, banner artwork, archaeological artifacts or flags.
